sourceText:
48 h Hollywood fasting drink
By: Easy cook - Lak...
Published: Monday, January 21, 2019 - 4:51am

Ingredients




1 banana, peeled
1 apple, peeled and cored
Juice of 4 oranges, freshly squeezed
Juice of 2 lemons, freshly squeezed
2 tbs honey (optional)
1 cup grape or red berries fruit juice (store bought, 100% juice)
1-2 l mineral or tap water

Preparation

1 Cut banana and apple into smaller chunks, put in a blender or mixer. 2 Add orange and lemon juice and honey, blend until smooth. 3 Add grape or red berries juice, stir. Transfer to a 2 l jug. 4 Add mineral or tap water, stir. keep cool in the fridge and sip the juice throughout the day. 5 This amount is enough for 1 day.

About

Fast for 48 h like Hollywood stars with this homemade, refreshing and all natural drink.
